description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Onboarding' that implements a multi-step onboarding form for users, including profile info, skills, resume upload, and navigation options.

methods.name: Onboarding({ navigateTo })
methods.description: React functional component handling multi-step user onboarding process, including input fields for user info, skills, resume upload, and navigation buttons.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the onboarding step to the next stage, up to a maximum of step 3.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Navigates away from onboarding to the user profile page, if the 'navigateTo' function is provided.
